paper_title: First results from a microwave cavity axion search at 24 micro-eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: First results from a microwave cavity axion search at 24 µeV. The paper reports exclusion of axion models with two-photon coupling g_agamma ≳ 2×10^-14 GeV^-1 over the mass range 23.55 < m_a < 24.0 µeV at 90% confidence. This represents the first cosmologically relevant sensitivity above 20 µeV, achieved using a dilution refrigerator and Josephson parametric amplifier. The local dark matter density ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is explicitly stated in Eq. (1) and used in the analysis. The coupling is the physical axion-photon coupling g_agamma = g_γ α/(π Λ^2) m_a, where g_γ is the model-dependent dimensionless coupling. The exclusion limit corresponds to |g_γ| ≳ 2.3 × g_γ^KSVZ. The mass range is encoded as a horizontal line at coupling 2×10^-14 GeV^-1 spanning 23.55–24.0 µeV. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 46)) | Vision: Exclusion limit plot from FIG. 3 of the paper. The main exclusion boundary (green shaded region, lower edge) traces the 90% confidence level limit on g_agamma vs axion mass m_a. The x-axis shows mass in μeV (converted to eV: 23.55–24.0 μeV = 2.355–2.400 × 10^-5 eV). The y-axis shows |g_agamma| in units of 10^-14 GeV^-1 (read from axis label). The boundary exhibits a characteristic peak around m_a ≈ 23.65 μeV (≈ 2.365 × 10^-5 eV) where the coupling reaches ~3 × 10^-14 GeV^-1, then decreases toward both lower and higher masses. The KSVZ and DFSZ theoretical model lines are shown as dashed horizontal lines at ~1 × 10^-14 and ~0.4 × 10^-14 GeV^-1 respectively. The inset shows the broader context (0–25 μeV) with previous limits from ADMX, RBF, and UF experiments.
